title: Demo of JSONL pages with code

message.text:
Two live demos, and each is a folder holding nothing but a page.jsonl, so the file is the code.
1) /framework/core/Page/jsonl/ is the basic one: it lists files, links a child page, and places a note.md and a content.js. Its source is core/Page/jsonl/page.jsonl (6 lines).
2) /framework/ux/Content/built/ is the richer one: prose plus Question and Decision modules placed from lines. Source: ux/Content/built/page.jsonl.
I can't say whether either page shows its own source next to the result; if you want that side by side, say so and I'll have a minion add it.
